description: Fetch the category-aware copy/install asset for a HeyClaude entry without writing local files. Pass assetType (e.g. 'install_command', 'config_snippet') to return only that asset and avoid the full_content/script payloads when you do not need them.

assetType.description: Return only this asset type instead of every asset. Use it to avoid paying for the full_content or script payload (up to tens of KB) when you only need, e.g., the install_command or config_snippet.

platform.description: Target platform to tailor the install command or config snippet.

slug.description: Slug of the entry to fetch the asset for.

name: entry.asset
